topic_ko: 세계 각지의 언어가 섞여 형성된 미국 영어와, 어휘·발음·철자에서 나타나는 영국 영어와의 차이

passage: The varieties of English used in the United States and Canada are together known as American English.
English arrived there with the British in the 16th century, and since then both countries have become melting pots shaped by languages from every corner of the world.
Newcomers from many lands carried their own tongues with them, and these languages helped form the standard American English we know today.
American English is frequently compared with British English, and the two differ in vocabulary, pronunciation, and spelling.
What Americans call a parking lot, for instance, is known as a car park in Britain.
Americans also pronounce the "r" in words such as car, hard, and market, while the British usually leave it silent.
In spelling, American English prefers "z" where British English often uses "s," as in realize and realise.
choices: American English: its origins and how it differs from British English
why British English is more correct than American English
the history of immigration laws in Canada
how to improve your English spelling
the disappearance of the letter "r" from English
theme.explanation_ko: 여러 언어가 섞여 형성된 미국 영어의 기원과, 영국 영어와의 어휘·발음·철자 차이를 다루므로 ①가 주제이다.
theme.distractor_ko: ② 어느 쪽이 더 옳은지 평가하지 않는다. ③ 캐나다 이민법은 다루지 않는다. ④ 철자 실력을 늘리는 법은 나오지 않는다. ⑤ r은 미국 영어에서 오히려 발음된다.
